edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged owner state variable.
Untrusted msg.sender becomes the initial owner during deployment.
transferOwnership writes the staged newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable to authorize the call.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the handover.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after transfer.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
Parameter _newOwner flows directly into the newOwner state variable.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor mints _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the entire supply into balances of the fixed deployer address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] from the balances mapping.
totalSupply feeds the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] into an unsafe arithmetic operation.
Unchecked subtraction result is returned as the total supply, allowing underflow.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
transfer mutates balances for sender and recipient.
transfer debits the sender balance through safeSub.
transfer credits the recipient balance through safeAdd.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer.
Parameter 'to' receives the credited tokens in transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' is the amount moved in transfer.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
Parameter spender is the allowance key target in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount stored in approve.
transferFrom mutates balances for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient.
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter 'from' is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowance mapping.
Parameter spender indexes the allowance mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approveAndCall.
Parameter spender is approved and then used as the callback target.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded into the external callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the untrusted spender contract's receiveApproval before returning.
Attacker-controlled spender address determines the target of the external callback.
Arbitrary data bytes are passed into the untrusted receiveApproval callback, enabling nested calls.
The approved token amount is handed to the external callback.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter transferFrom and drain the fresh allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an owner-supplied token contract, which can call back into the contract.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable to authorize the rescue function.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
Operand a flows into the checked safeAdd computation.
Operand b flows into the checked safeAdd computation.

Operand a flows into the checked safeSub computation.
Operand b flows into the checked safeSub computation.
Operand a flows into the checked safeMul computation.
Operand b flows into the checked safeMul computation.
Operand a flows into the checked safeDiv computation.
Operand b flows into the checked safeDiv computation.
